dominant_strengths: Sharp headline typography with a confident yellow highlight that anchors the value prop and creates clear hierarchy
Product screenshot is densely detailed yet legible, signaling craft and giving immediate proof of the tool's depth
Restrained neutral palette lets the bright blue CTA and yellow accent do precise attention work without noise
dominant_weaknesses: Bright blue CTA fights tonally with the warm yellow highlight; both compete as the page's primary chromatic anchor
Hero composition feels slightly top-heavy—huge whitespace above headline, app screenshot crammed near the fold edge
Design language is generic SaaS landing; little distinctive system identity beyond the logo mark and highlight motif
fix_priorities: Harmonize CTA hue with the yellow accent or desaturate one to remove chromatic competition
Rebalance vertical rhythm—tighten top padding, give the product preview more breathing room
Introduce a signature visual motif (calendar grid, time blocks) to differentiate from generic productivity hero pages
rationale.norman_balance: Strong behavioral clarity and decent reflective trust via the detailed preview, but visceral impact is muted by palette tension.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes—it clearly communicates an AI note-taking productivity tool with proof-of-product, though distinctiveness for the Amie brand is underplayed.
